title: osteospermum jucundum
intro: Osteospermum jucundum, commonly known as the daisy bush or blue-eyes, is a flowering plant in the daisy family native to South Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Osteospermum jucundum are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
